pieces.content:
Polia,

We saw these scraps on a whiteboard—the one before the room—I mean outside it—I gathered or collected all that was possible: (x,y)

(14,54) You know a little basket can be found in a chimney or the reeds. And we will keep that chimney clear or hew those reeds as a collective good / (35,24) The particle-set of the leaves will flutter off the tree when the request is filled / (20,43) Not everyone can do this! / (17,90) August Bank Holiday Island? / Our lack of ourness (maybe areness) / (53,53) Problem with using is the User / (15,110) The boundary of this truce

(A placeholder: "most people are fools—most authority is malignant—God does not exist—and everything is wrong")
pieces.title: Ark refactoring

pieces.content: "Not only that, but this instantaneous ruin presents whole new vistas to the imagination. Let me show you what I mean. Suppose you walk to another section while your lover waits for God. In this state, you no longer need to know what you think is important; you don’t need to know how the buildings here came together. And your shoes are too tight."
pieces.readme: The appearance in a strife of love of a disc which parses information-places.
pieces.title: Documentation waiting

pieces.content:
Yes art should be like a dream, she said. But
the kind of dream where you are doing chores or,
better, inventing a new way to keep things tidy.
And no idea is inlaid, all clouds have pants,
you and I are especially alike.
pieces.readme: Two items: a simulation of Otlet writing Briet's name in a conveyer or canon loop; and a transcript of a discussion had with Suzanne Briet in the kitchen at a party.
pieces.title: Dream anteloping

pieces.content:
Dear Cato I am still yours, a peak body
or Union of International Associations
and your distant honest Fruit Tree of
protected tended order and your buffer overrun
and will you need me any more? once
the new editions of the word en-Masse
are in harmony? Dear Cato I am inlaid
with business documents and school-books.

▧▧
pieces.readme: What Paul Otlet might have worried about, when he was trying to hold it together.
pieces.title: Dearness massing

pieces.content:
Our mascot is a Bell frog
in the eye of the bole of a tree.
And each part a ghost. You can tell
just by the way their edges dash.

The Bell frog is ringing like a web-
socket—every three seconds—
"be see, be see," on it rings. And
we chose their metatarsal hop.

You, trance-ending particle. You
amphibious service call.
